gen-fs-expose-gf-alexandria: Alexandria stands tall and open, its short stems keeping every line easy on the eye. Under Expose, a tightly packed display heading, it would carry long paragraphs with a relaxed, sans-serif steadiness.
gen-fs-expose-gf-amiko: Chunky, modern lowercase from Amiko, with terminals flaring outward like tongs, sits beneath the tightly clipped Expose heading. Strong contrast, sharply dressed.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-bangla: Expose packs its heading tight, with almost no gap between lowercase and capitals, and a refined, striking edge. And Anek Bangla follows with wide, barely curled s shapes in a plain sans that feels friendly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-devanagari: Striking is the first impression from Expose, compressed and sharp. Anek Devanagari underneath has open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, so paragraphs of text would move along smoothly in plain sans form.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-gujarati: Tight headline, generous text: Expose clips its lines close while Anek Gujarati lets its lowercase rival the capitals. And its gaping openings would keep a long stretch of sans-serif reading comfortable.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Expose is tightly compressed, with hardly any gap between lowercase and capitals, which gives it a striking, refined bite. Anek Gurmukhi, a plain sans with big open counters, suits generous body sizing.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-kannada: Expose brings a striking, refined display heading with hardly any pause between its lowercase and capitals. Anek Kannada, a sans-serif with a high x-height, would read briskly over pages.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly touching the capitals. Beneath the tightly spaced Expose, this plain sans holds its letters open, so a long page would read with an easy, modern flow.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-malayalam: Clean lines come from Anek Malayalam, a sans whose curve tips never quite touch. Expose, striking and compressed, earns its keep as a big, short heading.
gen-fs-expose-gf-anek-odia: Compressed meets contemporary here: Expose runs tight and striking up top. And Anek Odia, a sans with unlatched rounds and capitals just above lowercase, would keep a long page of text feeling clean.
